overview_description.description: Vulcan Technologies is an advanced prosthetic research company specializing in application of SMA wires. They are developing a partial hand prosthesis system that is lightweight, has a lower cost of manufacture and boasts superior functionality. Through our proprietary shape memory alloy technology relatively noiseless prosthetic fingers can be made that fully simulate lost functionality.
